study type: Pooled analyses and individual participant data meta-analyses
cohort: 17,189 controls, 10,782 ALL cases, and 1,690 AML cases from 16 studies in the Childhood Leukemia International Consortium (CLIC)
finding: Longer breastfeeding duration was associated with decreased odds of both ALL and AML.
mod_finding: Findings were unchanged in sensitivity analyses adjusted for mode of delivery.
